name: Cantiere Android offline ML Kit Flutter image-label plugin
description: Reusable Android Flutter plugin with actual Cantiere-derived Kotlin ML Kit bundled on-device image-classification bridge, FlutterPlugin registration, local MethodChannel Dart API, source-pinned pure Dart label processor and unit tests. No physical-device result claimed.

security.notes: Derived Cantiere Kotlin source and ML Kit dependency not independently certified for production. No physical device inference, battery, or privacy runtime validation.

integration.adapter_notes: Plugin auto-registers Cantiere ML Kit labelImage bridge on the original com.aiorchestrator/local_image_vision channel. DO NOT co-install with original Cantiere MainActivity explicit LocalImageVisionBridge.register() on same engine. For new Flutter projects, add as path dependency; test in isolated Android host. Host handles user file selection and privacy. No install/update in Riserva.
known_constraints: Android-only image inference; Linux support limited to mocked Flutter MethodChannel tests.
No OCR, precise colors, counting, text-image grounding or full multimodal LLM.
Native bridge uses original Cantiere 8 MiB input, memory floor 256 MiB, 1024-px decoded edge and confidence threshold.
ML Kit model dependency must be bundled at build time; no user data is uploaded by this plugin.
Android APK compilation cannot verify actual ML Kit outputs, device performance or physical Galaxy S24 FE behavior.
Original Cantiere app must migrate away from its explicit local image channel registration before using this standalone plugin.
Internal experimental source only; third-party dependency compliance/security and redistribution approval pending.
